name: Calculus
description: Limits, continuity, differentiation, maxima and minima, mean value theorems and integration for GATE.

nodes.name: Functions & graphs
nodes.desc: Real functions, composition, piecewise definitions, polynomials and roots.
nodes.summary: You will be able to work with real functions, compose them, handle piecewise definitions and locate roots of polynomials.

nodes.name: Limits & continuity
nodes.desc: Limits, one-sided limits, continuity, kinds of discontinuity and the intermediate value theorem.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate limits, test continuity, classify discontinuities and apply the intermediate value theorem.
topics: Continuity at a point and on intervals

nodes.name: Evaluating limits
nodes.desc: Standard limits, rationalisation, squeeze theorem and L'Hôpital's rule for indeterminate forms.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate difficult limits using standard limits, rationalisation, the squeeze theorem and L'Hôpital's rule.
topics: Standard limits like sin x over x
Indeterminate forms like 1 to the infinity

nodes.name: Sequences & series
nodes.desc: Convergence of sequences and recursively defined sequences, fixed points, power series and radius of convergence.
nodes.summary: You will be able to test sequences and series for convergence, find fixed points of recursive sequences and compute radius of convergence.
topics: Recursively defined sequences and fixed points
Power series and radius of convergence

nodes.name: Derivatives
nodes.desc: Differentiability, derivative rules, the chain rule and implicit differentiation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to test differentiability and compute derivatives using the standard rules, the chain rule and implicit differentiation.

nodes.name: Mean value theorems
nodes.desc: Rolle's theorem, Lagrange's mean value theorem and Cauchy's mean value theorem.
nodes.summary: You will be able to apply Rolle's, Lagrange's and Cauchy's mean value theorems and check their hypotheses.

nodes.name: Taylor series
nodes.desc: Taylor and Maclaurin expansions, higher derivatives and using series to approximate and take limits.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write Taylor and Maclaurin expansions and use them to approximate functions and evaluate limits.

nodes.name: Maxima & minima
nodes.desc: Critical points, first and second derivative tests, local versus global extrema on closed intervals.
nodes.summary: You will be able to find critical points and classify local and global extrema using derivative tests on intervals.

nodes.name: Monotonic & convex
nodes.desc: Increasing and decreasing functions, concavity, inflection points and convex functions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to determine where functions increase or decrease, find inflection points and recognise convex functions.

nodes.name: Optimisation problems
nodes.desc: Turning word problems into functions and optimising them.
nodes.summary: You will be able to turn word problems into functions of one variable and find their optimal values with calculus.

nodes.name: Integration
nodes.desc: Antiderivatives, definite integrals, substitution, integration by parts and the fundamental theorem.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute antiderivatives and definite integrals using substitution, integration by parts and the fundamental theorem.

nodes.name: Integral properties
nodes.desc: Odd and even symmetry, periodic and absolute-value integrands, and comparing sums with integrals.
nodes.summary: You will be able to simplify definite integrals using symmetry, periodicity and absolute values, and compare sums with integrals.

nodes.name: Improper integrals
nodes.desc: Infinite limits and unbounded integrands, convergence tests and the Gaussian integral.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate improper integrals with infinite limits or unbounded integrands and test their convergence.

nodes.name: Area & volume
nodes.desc: Area between curves, volumes of revolution and arc length.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute areas between curves, volumes of solids of revolution and arc lengths with definite integrals.

nodes.name: Numerical methods
nodes.desc: Newton–Raphson root finding, and the trapezoidal and Simpson's rules for integration.
nodes.summary: You will be able to find roots with Newton-Raphson and approximate integrals with the trapezoidal and Simpson's rules.

nodes.name: Partial derivatives
nodes.desc: Functions of several variables, partial derivatives, the multivariable chain rule and the gradient.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute partial derivatives of multivariable functions, apply the multivariable chain rule and find gradients.

nodes.name: Multivariable calculus
nodes.desc: Gradients, the Hessian, saddle points and extrema of functions of two variables.
nodes.summary: You will be able to locate and classify extrema of two-variable functions using gradients, the Hessian and saddle point tests.
topics: Second derivative test with rt - s^2

nodes.name: Multiple integrals
nodes.desc: Double integrals, surface integrals, curl, divergence and the divergence theorem.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate double integrals, change their order, and apply curl, divergence and the divergence theorem.

nodes.name: Lagrange multipliers
nodes.desc: Constrained optimisation with Lagrange multipliers.
nodes.summary: You will be able to solve constrained optimisation problems using Lagrange multipliers.

nodes.name: Differential equations
nodes.desc: First-order and linear ODEs, boundary value problems and a glimpse of Laplace and Fourier methods.
nodes.summary: You will be able to solve first-order and linear ordinary differential equations and recognise Laplace and Fourier methods.
topics: Linear first-order equations and integrating factors
Second-order linear equations with constant coefficients
